result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the header, location, search bar, filter chips, promo banner, carousels, and restaurant cards are aligned and legible. The clipped chip and carousel items at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and were not counted. I found one likely copy typo and one minor contrast concern.

issues.description: The search placeholder appears to read "Restarants, dishes, groceries", which is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to "Restaurants, dishes, groceries".

issues.description: Secondary grey text (delivery fees, the "(500+)" review count, and the "25–35 min" meta line) is light grey on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1) for small text.
